jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II- Structures
jobs.description_text: About This Role As the Manufacturing Engineer II- Structures at Varda, you will own the manufacturing processes for primary and secondary structural assemblies that form the backbone of our reentry capsules and spacecraft. From composite layup and cure operations to machined metallic substructures and bonded panel assemblies, you will bridge the gap between structural design intent and production reality. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with structural design engineers and a skilled technician team to drive process discipline, eliminate rework, and steadily increase vehicle build cadence. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how parts are actually made, not just how they are designed, and who is energized by the challenge of scaling a complex aerospace manufacturing operation. This role is open at the Engineer II and Senior level, with levels determined based on candidate experience. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer- Thermal Protection System (TPS)
jobs.description_text: About This Role As a Manufacturing Engineer- Thermal Protection System (TPS) at Varda, you will own the manufacturing processes for the ablative and insulative materials that protect our reentry capsules during the most demanding phase of the mission- reentry. TPS manufacturing is one of the most technically specialized disciplines in aerospace, requiring deep expertise in ablative material processing, bonding, tiling, and surface preparation. You will develop and maintain the processes that ensure every capsule's heatshield is built to survive reentry conditions, working at the frontier of materials science and production engineering. This is a rare opportunity to own a critical, high-visibility manufacturing domain at a company that is already demonstrating reentry capability on orbit. This role is open at the L2 and Senior level, with levels determined based on candidate experience. jobs.title: Propulsion Components Engineer
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda is hiring an experienced Propulsion Components Engineer to join the team that designs, builds, tests, and flies the fluid components on the W-Series satellite bus and future vehicles. The W-Series satellite incorporates a high-test hydrogen peroxide (HTP) and hydrocarbon bipropellant propulsion system with high-pressure inert gas pressurization and cold-gas attitude control. The component portfolio spans each of these fluid subsystems and includes solenoid control valves, check valves, relief valves, burst disks, fluid filters, regulators, manually operated service valves, machined fluid manifolds, and instrumentation including pressure transducers and RTDs. A successful candidate will take on a significant share of the component ownership for these mission-critical hardware articles as responsible engineer, helping expand component capabilities, improve reliability, and increase flight cadence. Many current Varda components are purchased parts, and you will be a primary technical interface to our suppliers. Varda also intends to bring more component design in-house for current and future vehicles, and you will help lead that transition: shaping make-versus-buy decisions, executing detailed design, and standing up the capabilities to develop, qualify, produce, acceptance test, and fly Varda-owned parts. jobs.description_text: About the Role This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization. Verkada runs on four value streams — Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them. The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Reporting to the Technical Support Manager, the Technical Support Analyst II role combines remote technical assistance with on-site deployment and hardware troubleshooting, serving as a key resource for customer project startups, field diagnostics, and hardware replacement. Our ideal candidate is a technical, versatile problem-solver with a strong desire to always provide the best and most efficient customer service. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites (up to 50%), with occasional adjustment of work hours to support project schedules. *This is an office-based role when not traveling to customer sites.

jobs.title: Account Manager, California/Washington
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per account for 2–3 days (supporting accounts in Northern California and the Seattle, Washington area). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, meaning some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is a remote role, but candidates must be based on the West Coast (preferably within driving distance or short regional flight access to Northern California or the Seattle, WA area) to accommodate monthly client visits.

jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan

The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.
